class.name: BoxVoxelEdit
class.brief_description: An edit that fills an axis-aligned box with one material.
class.description: BoxVoxelEdit fills an axis-aligned box of the given position and size with one material.

members.member: The material the box is filled with: [code]254[/code] for air, carving matter out, or [code]0[/code] to [code]253[/code] for the opaque materials, adding matter.
The lowest corner of the box, in voxel coordinates.
The size of the box, in voxels, extending from [member position].
